days.title: Main Hall - Friday

items.title: Pre-con Social in the Leonardo Bar
items.description: Friday night is a chance to re-enact Mos Eisley Cantina, Ten Forward, or hte White Hart. Activities have been planned — you have been warned!

days.note: Everything is in the Main Hall unless otherwise stated. There's also a Dealers Room and a Gaming Room.

items.title: Opening Ceremony
items.description: Starting with a magical procession from breakfast, we'll introduce our guests, the committee, the programme, life, the universe, and everything.

items.title: Book Launches
items.description: The Sword and the Sequel by J. R. Steel and David Wake, and The Raven's Way by David Wake.

items.title: Interview
items.subtitle: Mike Collins
items.description: Dave Trace asks our guest about his comics and his illustrations.

items.title: Lunch break
items.subtitle: ArmadaCraft / Rehearsal
items.description:
Doctor Who-themed squares, organised by Vicky Vagg.
Masquerade walk-through and cabaret planning will be in the Main Hall.

items.title: Auction
items.description: Fantastic, incredible, and must-have items to bid on and buy!

items.title: Guest
items.subtitle: Andy Lane
items.description: Our guest talks about his books, his writing, and his life.

items.title: Talk
items.subtitle: O Captain! My Captain!
items.description: Audience discussion on captains led by Dave Trace. Who do you back — Kirk or Picard, Scarlet or Tartan, Caruthers or Loveridge?

items.title: Panel
items.subtitle: Watching the Detectives
items.description: Depictions of policing and crime prevention in SF and Fantasy. Examples include: The Demolished Man, Hashtag, Minority Report. Andy Lane, Mike Collins, Jonny Nexus, Tlanti, and David Wake discuss.

items.title: Masquerade and Cabaret
items.description: Including Barry's Contractual Obligation Video Clips and readings from Marion Pitman.

days.title: Main Hall - Sunday

items.title: Talk
items.subtitle: Unstable Atoms
items.description: From the Big Bang to Making Electricity — a talk by Mr Denzil Brown. A brief history of radioactivity from its discover to how we harnessed it to make electricity. With a look into the possible future of Nuclear Power and a couple of detours to the wacky and sometimes dangerous uses of unstable atoms.

items.title: Talk
items.subtitle: The Earth Isn't At the Centre of the Universe!
items.description:
The Sun hasn't always been at the centre of the Solar System. Gary Loveridge introduces you to the history and the people who put it there.
Spoiler: It always was, but people didn't always believe this.

items.title: Talk
items.subtitle: Doctor Who and its Future
items.description: Guests Andy Lane and Mike Collins discuss all things Whovian with Ali Trace, their involvement, and what they'd do next.

items.title: Panel Item
items.subtitle: Turkey Readings
items.description: New and even worse readings for charity.

items.title: Talk
items.subtitle: Young Sherlock Holmes
items.description: With the new series of Young Sherlock Holmes on Amazon Prime, this is a chance for our guests Mike Collins and Andy Lane, who both had input into the series, to give us their deductions.

items.title: Dead Hound of the Baskervilles Party
items.description: Another chance to re-enact Millidaves, Quark's, or the Prancing Pony.

days.note: Rooms need to be cleared by 18:00.
